GET /A_PaymentAdvice: Reads all available payment advices.
POST /A_PaymentAdvice: Creates a new payment advice.

GET /A_PaymentAdvice(CompanyCode='{CompanyCode}',PaymentAdviceAccountType='{PaymentAdviceAccountType}',PaymentAdviceAccount='{PaymentAdviceAccount}',PaymentAdvice='{PaymentAdvice}'): Reads a specific payment advice.

PATCH /A_PaymentAdvice(CompanyCode='{CompanyCode}',PaymentAdviceAccountType='{PaymentAdviceAccountType}',PaymentAdviceAccount='{PaymentAdviceAccount}',PaymentAdvice='{PaymentAdvice}'): Updates a specific payment advice.

DELETE /A_PaymentAdvice(CompanyCode='{CompanyCode}',PaymentAdviceAccountType='{PaymentAdviceAccountType}',PaymentAdviceAccount='{PaymentAdviceAccount}',PaymentAdvice='{PaymentAdvice}'): Deletes a specific payment advice.

GET /A_PaymentAdvice(CompanyCode='{CompanyCode}',PaymentAdviceAccountType='{PaymentAdviceAccountType}',PaymentAdviceAccount='{PaymentAdviceAccount}',PaymentAdvice='{PaymentAdvice}')/to_PaymentAdviceItem: Reads all item fields for a specific payment advice header.

POST /A_PaymentAdvice(CompanyCode='{CompanyCode}',PaymentAdviceAccountType='{PaymentAdviceAccountType}',PaymentAdviceAccount='{PaymentAdviceAccount}',PaymentAdvice='{PaymentAdvice}')/to_PaymentAdviceItem: Creates items for a specific payment advice header.
GET /A_PaymentAdviceItem: Reads all item fields for all payment advice headers.
POST /A_PaymentAdviceItem: Creates items for a specific payment advice header.

GET /A_PaymentAdviceItem(CompanyCode='{CompanyCode}',PaymentAdviceAccountType='{PaymentAdviceAccountType}',PaymentAdviceAccount='{PaymentAdviceAccount}',PaymentAdvice='{PaymentAdvice}',PaymentAdviceItem='{PaymentAdviceItem}'): Reads all fields of a specific payment advice item.

PATCH /A_PaymentAdviceItem(CompanyCode='{CompanyCode}',PaymentAdviceAccountType='{PaymentAdviceAccountType}',PaymentAdviceAccount='{PaymentAdviceAccount}',PaymentAdvice='{PaymentAdvice}',PaymentAdviceItem='{PaymentAdviceItem}'): Updates items for a specific payment advice header.

DELETE /A_PaymentAdviceItem(CompanyCode='{CompanyCode}',PaymentAdviceAccountType='{PaymentAdviceAccountType}',PaymentAdviceAccount='{PaymentAdviceAccount}',PaymentAdvice='{PaymentAdvice}',PaymentAdviceItem='{PaymentAdviceItem}'): Deletes a specific payment advice item.
